notes: The dock wears the app's own rabbit, monochrome in your accent, and it carries live download progress as a ring. Appearance and Updates pages are rebuilt — theme rows, a new accent palette, real release notes and a moving download bar. The extractor page shows its three parts with one action each, and yt-dlp now keeps itself fresh automatically on Wi-Fi. Plus: shared pages hand their video straight to aria2, .html links read as pages, and the empty screen's torrent button opens the real file picker.
